title: Application error - Application cannot be started
author: Praveen
content: I am unable to open the OneStream application and getting 'Application cannot be started' error after downloads.
solution_text: You can try to clear your Clickonce cache. Log out of OneStream, Delete the Settings folder in C:\Users\USERNAME\AppData\Roaming\OneStream\Desktop\Settings, Delete the 2.0 folder in C:\Users\USERNAME\AppData\Local\Apps\2.0
